_note: SOLO: a single Claude Pro seat — no Codex/Grok/Cursor. The user assigned the dispatcher to their single Claude seat (the only seat they own); with no other seat to fan work out to, that same seat also codes and reviews — the 'dispatcher delegates, never implements on its own account' rule yields only because there is literally no other seat (never-strand). Dispatch is user-assigned; the single-dispatcher invariant is unchanged; only the holder moves.

claude-code.note: dispatches, codes, and reviews — the whole engine on one seat
